title: Input & Output Devices
summary: Sort and identify devices that send information in and out.

content.text: Computers need ways to receive information from us, and ways to send information back to us.

points.text: Input Devices: Send information INTO the computer (like typing or clicking).
Output Devices: Send information OUT of the computer (like pictures on a screen or sound).

steps.boltSpeech: Help me sort these devices! Drag or click them to the right category.
steps.instructions: Sort the devices into Input (sending data IN) or Output (getting data OUT).

questions.prompt: When you type on a keyboard, what are you doing?
questions.explanation: Typing sends letters INTO the computer, so it is an input device.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an OUTPUT device?
questions.explanation: Headphones play sound OUT to you, making them an output device. Webcams and scanners take pictures IN.

points.text: Input devices (mouse, keyboard, mic) put data IN.
Output devices (screen, printer, speakers) get data OUT.
